messages:
Anya (People Ops): Heads up — need provisional band elevation approval for candidate EXT-527. Manager requesting bump from IC3 -> IC4 due to prior team lead + 4 yrs relevant experience. Candidate also asked to defer start to 2026-06-01 for visa/housing. Can we route this? Key numbers below.

Anya (People Ops): Details:
```
role: Backend Engineer
manager: Jon
requested_base: $170,000
requested_sign_on: $10,000 (one-time)
current_band_range(IC3): $130,000 - $155,000
target_band_range(IC4): $150,000 - $175,000
requested_start: 2026-06-01 (deferred)
reason: previous lead experience, critical proj ramp
```

Anya (People Ops): @Jon can you add 1-2 line justification for comp committee? :eyes:

Lia (Recruiter): Confirming candidate is our top choice and would accept with staged sign-on. Candidate asked specifically to defer start due to visa interview timeline.

Ravi (Comp): Need a short calibration note and any benchmark data — link to market comp or recent similar hires. If we elevate provisionally we'll document delta and set review after 6 months. Also: deferred start affects benefit eligibility and payroll timing.

Jon (Hiring Manager): Quick justification: candidate led a team of 3 backend engs at last role, shipped cross-team infra that reduced latency by 30%. Hiring on roadmap critical piece (real-time routing). Benchmark: similar hire last quarter was at $168k in IC4 (see hiring-dashboard/benchmarks link). Happy to commit to 90-day performance review.

Jon (Hiring Manager): I approve the requested $170k + $10k sign-on on my org budget. Prefer staged sign-on: 50% at start, 50% after 90d.

Anya (People Ops): OK routing plan: 1) Ravi to add to comp-committee agenda (Fri 10am) 2) Finance quick-check on cashflow for sign-on 3) People Ops to prepare provisional offer wording (note deferred start). Need final decision by EOD Friday to keep offer window open with candidate.

offer-bot: Offer draft created: OFF-2026-4392 (status: draft). Linked to ticket HIR-8812.

Ravi (Comp): Added to Friday agenda. Quick ask — if start >30d, benefits eligibility will likely shift; confirm candidate preference on benefits effective date (first of month vs 30 days).

Lia (Recruiter): Candidate prefers benefits to kick in at first eligible date rather than wait an extra month. Also requests remote-first arrangement (US PST overlap).

Anya (People Ops): Noted. Finance: @ravi please flag whether staged sign-on needs Finance approval beyond normal OKR spend.

Ravi (Comp): Finance flagged no extra approval needed for $10k on this band but we need written justification for the provisional elevation in the packet.

Jon (Hiring Manager): Adding justification doc link: https://company.share/hiring/EXT-527-calibration.pdf — includes interview scorecards and manager note. :thumbsup:

Anya (People Ops): Great. I'll assemble the packet and ping comp-committee now. If committee signs off, we'll issue offer with deferred 2026-06-01 start and staged sign-on (50/50). Will update thread here.

Lia (Recruiter): Thanks — I'll hold candidate communication until we have final sign-off.

offer-bot: Reminder: draft saved. "Do not send" flag set until approval.

Anya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — target to close by Friday EOD. :raised_hands:
